title: NYISO Integrated Real-Time Actual Load record
description: Integrated real-time actual load in MWh by zone. One object per row of NYISO MIS public archive CSV report P-58C (http://mis.nyiso.com/public/csv/palIntegrated/<YYYYMMDD>palIntegrated.csv). DERIVED by API Evangelist from the header row and observed values of a live file fetched on 2026-07-27; NYISO publishes no schema document for this report. Timestamps are rendered by NYISO as MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM[:SS] in Eastern time, not ISO-8601.

time_stamp.title: Time Stamp
time_stamp.description: CSV column "Time Stamp"; observed example value: 07/26/2026 00:00:00

time_zone.title: Time Zone
time_zone.description: CSV column "Time Zone"; observed example value: EDT

name.title: Name
name.description: CSV column "Name"; observed example value: CAPITL

integrated_load.title: Integrated Load
integrated_load.description: CSV column "Integrated Load"; observed example value: 1332.9635
